column1: Daily Weather Observations for Dartmoor, Victoria for October 2022
Prepared at 13:01 UTC on Thursday  8 June 2023   IDCJDW3101.202210
Most observations from Dartmoor, but evaporation and sunshine from Mt Gambier.

Mt Gambier is about 50 km to the west of Dartmoor, and conditions may differ markedly between the two on any given day; the results for evaporation and sunshine, and the climate averages listed below, should be used with caution.
Temperature, humidity, wind, pressure and rainfall observations are from Dartmoor {station 090194}
Evaporation and sunshine observations are from Mount Gambier Aero {station 026021}
